checks.transcription: Ah, there you are. Welcome to our little picnic. Your other mother has packed enough food to feed half the village. So I do hope you've brought an appetite.
Oh, those sandwiches look marvelous. Would you mind passing one over here, kiddo? I seem to have gotten myself rather comfortable.
Ah, that was splendid, good food, lovely scenery and wonderful company. I don't think we could have asked for a nicer afternoon.
Ah, ready to catch something. I brought plenty of bait and I have a feeling the fish are going to be awfully cooperative today. Come on, let's get those lines in the water.
Now, don't pull too soon. Give it a moment. Let the fish take the bait and then give the rod a good tug. There you are. You've got the idea.
Well, that was a lovely bit of fishing. I don't think I've had this much fun with a rod and ages. We ought to do this again sometime.
Ah, there you are. Just look at that sky. Your other mother tells me the stars are especially bright tonight. I brought my telescope so we can have a proper look.
See those three bright little stars over there. They make a rather lovely pattern, don't they? Take a look through the telescope. You might be surprised what you find.
Ah, wonderful. There is something rather special about looking up at all those stars. Isn't there? Makes the whole world feel just a little bit more magical.
Ah! Ready for a walk, kiddo! Your other mother has picked out a beautiful little path for us! I've heard there is a rather lovely waterfall somewhere along the way!
Oh, would you look at that? Isn't nature extraordinary? I've never seen flowers quite like those before. Your other mother certainly knows how to make a garden grow.
Well, that was refreshing. A lovely walk, a bit of fresh air, and some beautiful sights. I think I could get used to doing that every day!
Oh, all aboard. I've got the boat ready. And your other mother has planned a lovely route for us. Just find yourself a comfortable seat, and I'll handle the steering.
Would you look at that view? The water's so calm you can almost see the stars reflected in it. Beautiful, isn't it? Mind you don't lean too far over.
And there we are, safe and sound. Not a bad little voyage. If I do say so myself, I hope you enjoyed the ride as much as I did.

note: ASR checks words, not acting. Human listening review is not replaced by these checks.
